summary: Iteration 2 tested end-to-end (Bank Data, Board Harian, Peta Skor, entry_requirements, cron, new CardModal). Backend: 22/22 new pytest cases + 27/27 iteration-1 regression = 49/49 pass. Verified GET /api/bank-data/{division_id} (division, boards+lists, items enriched, workload with total & by_list), cross-division create via /work-items (Dewi CS → ADMIN PAJAK) allowed, entry_requirements migration on CS SKOR 3/4/5/6 lists, move blocked with proper Indonesian error 'Syarat masuk … belum terpenuhi: KTP, NPWP' for staff, supervisor bypass with activity log, auto-checklist 'Syarat SKOR 3…' created on card entering list, then move allowed after all items checked. Board Harian: hari_stage=1 auto-set when card enters SKOR 5, STAGE_GATES enforce AKTA+SK for HARI 4 (400 for staff), NIB for FINISH (target_stage=8 → 400 without NIB), LOGO warning returned in response.warning field. RBAC: /global/hari 403 for CS (dewi), 200 for admin & draf (elis). /global/skor 200 for CS & supervisor, 403 for draf/pajak. Cron POST /api/cron/advance-hari: 401 no auth, 401 wrong secret, 200 with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, idempotent via X-Webhook-Id (duplicate:true on 2nd call). Frontend: sidebar shows 5 bankdata divisions + nav-global-hari + nav-global-skor for admin, Bank Data page loads with 5 division tabs and workload panel, add modal shows 'Assign ke: <Division> (otomatis)' pill + optional PIC checkboxes, Board Harian renders 8 columns (HARI 1-7 + FINISH) with Graha card in HARI 1, Peta Skor renders 6 columns with 11 cards + read-only badge + no drag, CardModal has card-pic-list (avatar+name) + card-activity-rail + toggle-activity-details, Atur Syarat Masuk dropdown+modal opens for admin on CS DEDES ALI list, Dewi (CS staff) sees /global/hari forbidden UI (global-hari-forbidden testid).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_work.py move_item: reqs and hari-transition side effects correctly guarded by list-change check (target_list.id != item.list_id) — prevents infinite loop.

routes_work.py move_item: warning variable declared but never returned to caller in body of block (line ~271 return contains 'warning': warning — None). LOGO warning only surfaces via POST /work-items/{id}/hari, not via /move — consistent with spec.
cron_jobs.py advance_hari_job: only advances current+1, respects STAGE_GATES 4/6, but no gate for stage 8 (FINISH) — correct since spec says FINISH is manual.
server.py cron endpoint: uses hmac.compare_digest — safe against timing attacks; asyncio.create_task ensures 2xx returned immediately per spec.
routes_work.py global_skor: bucket assignment falls through many elif branches — cards in unmapped states silently dropped. Fine per spec (only CS lists & hari_stage counted).
seed migrate_stage_requirements: idempotent via {entry_requirements:{$exists:false}} filter — good.
routes_work.py can_access_hari: relies on division.key ∈ {draf,pajak,perizinan,desain} — verified in tests (elis draf allowed, dewi cs denied).
